snippet.title: Samurai Gunn 2 - New World:  The Cemetery! [ Outdated Content from 2022 Early Access Build ]
snippet.description:
Play Samurai Gunn 2 now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397790/Samurai_Gunn_2/

Join our Discord community! http://discord.gg/jKtVxbe

The second major update to Samurai Gunn 2 is now live!

The path to the haunted cemetery opens...

[This is content from the 2022 Early Access build of Samurai GUNN 2. This area can still be played by selecting the 2022 Build from the Beta options in the game's properties on Steam.]
